operation.description: Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Returns a client's loyalty-points summary: current `points`, the points-to-currency `factor`, the configured `creditType`, and the account's loyalty-points limit check. The client is identified by the `id` path parameter; there is no request body. Requires the **Client Loyalty** plugin to be enabled — when it is not, the endpoint responds with an empty object `{}`.

200.description: Loyalty-points summary for the client. When the Client Loyalty plugin is not enabled on the account, an empty object `{}` is returned instead.

points.description: The client's accrued loyalty points as of today.

factor.description: Points-to-currency conversion factor. `null` when no factor is configured.

checkSiteLimitLoyaltyPts.description: Result of the account plan's loyalty-points limit check. `true` when within limit; otherwise an object describing the limit.
